22944: Arrancar in Sōsuke Aizen's army. She, along with Loly, was ordered to bring Orihime Inoue to Sōsuke Aizen when he wanted to show her the Hōgyoku. Menoly is a teenage, female Arrancar.

57685: One of the Shinigami that replaces Zennosuke Kurumadani as the guardian of the Karakura Town area. Ryūnosuke is a timid and soft person.

65091: Hidetomo Kajōmaru s the 6th Seat of the 13th Division in the Gotei 13, under Captain Jūshirō Ukitake
